name: film-finish
summary: The last pass over a picture drawn by code, which comes out too clean: far things into the air, red and blue a little apart toward the corners and the corners darker, then the light still above a threshold spills (bloom and a red-orange halation), then grain new every frame; in that order, each kept small.
use: st = state(params, t); canvas(ctx, st, src, { depth }) with src the finished picture (a full-frame 2D canvas, or a Three.js renderer's canvas right after renderer.render) and depth an optional full-frame canvas, white = far. Draw the text that must be read after it. In Three.js the air is better as scene.fog (true distance); haze is for pictures with a depth canvas. playbook/08 成片的收尾.

slots.name: amount
slots.text: the whole pass: 0 off, 1 as set; above 1 every defect scales up together (a look-dev 'harder' preset, playbook/08 预设栈)

slots.name: haze
slots.text: air: how far the farthest things (depth 1) go toward hazeColor; 0 = off. Needs a depth canvas

slots.name: hazeColor
slots.text: air: the colour of the air, the sky's at the horizon

slots.name: hazeDesat
slots.text: air: how much colour the farthest things lose

slots.name: aberration
slots.text: lens: red and blue apart at the corners, a fraction of the frame's width (0.0012 ≈ 2 px at 1080p); none at the centre

slots.name: vignette
slots.text: lens: how much the corners darken

slots.name: bloom
slots.text: light: neutral glow round what is brighter than threshold

slots.name: halation
slots.text: light: a red-orange halo round the same light (film's)

slots.name: threshold
slots.text: light: the luma above which light spills; text that must be read stays under it or is drawn after the pass

slots.name: radius
slots.text: light: how far it spills (about two standard deviations of the Gaussian)

slots.name: grain
slots.text: medium: the grain's standard deviation in the mid-tones, 0..1 of full scale (0.02 is about 5 levels of 255); less in the blacks and whites

slots.name: grainSize
slots.text: medium: a grain's size in CSS px (follows the frame's dpr)

slots.name: grainFps
slots.text: medium: new grain this many times a second; 0 = every frame. A rate that does not divide the timeline's holds some grain for two frames: 24 on a 30 fps film repeats one frame in five, a 6 Hz stutter in the grain. 24 fits a 24 fps film; on 30 fps use 0, 15 or 30

slots.name: seed
slots.text: medium: a new seed, a new grain pattern (the frame, or the grain step, picks it: the same frame, the same grain)

sample.text: the contact sheet's moments: clean, then with air, with the lens, clean and finished side by side, and a 3x crop of a lamp clean and finished (the grain and the halation show there)

provenance.note: own code; the five kinds of defect and their order follow a compositor's habit of finishing a CG shot (idea only)
